context:
（又累又餓
呵欠連連地在配信的🌸）

姊街說有牡蠣🦪可以給她們
🌸就跟🌽一起去☄️🏠拿了
結果🦪很大
🌸不曉得要如何料理
應該明天會煮成火鍋了

話說⋯與其數🌸去☄️🏠的日子
不如數🌸沒有去的日子比較容易吧？！

還有姊街完全就是把🌸當家人一樣照顧了啊
商業到底跑到哪裡去了

(🌸, Feeling tired and hungry, yawning repeatedly during the stream)

Anemachi mentioned she had a batch of oysters 🦪 for them.
🌸 went to ☄️’s🏠 with 🌽 to pick them up.
It turned out the 🦪 were huge!
🌸 isn’t sure how to prepare them, but they’ll probably be made into a hot pot tomorrow.

By the way… instead of counting the days 🌸 goes to ☄️🏠, wouldn’t it be easier to count the days she doesn’t go there?!

Also, Anemachi treats 🌸 like family, taking such good care of her.
Where did the business part even go?
